statement: Downside case: operating revenue at 50% of the base case
Kiva scenario: $5,000 over 24 months at 0% (inside Kiva's published $1,000-$15,000 range); a scenario, not a request
Kiva scenario: $10,000 over 36 months at 0%; a scenario, not a request

Use-of-funds tiers of $5k/$10k/$15k/$25k/$50k are planning scenarios, not funding requests
Debt-service coverage of 1.25 is used as a common lender reference point, not any specific lender's rule
2025 depreciation is a non-cash expense; the asset list is in the tax preparer's records, and the workstation PC (~$1,500) was bought on credit and is paid off
90-day plan items are owner-proposed targets, not commitments or forecasts
Solo founder capacity; weekly hours available for delivery vs. funding work are not yet set by the owner
Proposed first segment: small organizations in Gwinnett/metro Atlanta needing automation, web or AI-workflow help; owner has not chosen a segment
Pricing is not set; no rates are assumed
R&D concepts are unvalidated; novelty requires a literature and prior-art review before any claim
Commercialization statements are hypotheses to test through customer discovery interviews
Workspace options need written quotes; no prices are assumed
Business-trip frequency and distance are unknown; the only evidence is $455 of 2025 car/truck expense
Equipment items are candidates for owner confirmation; no prices are assumed and 2025 purchases are excluded
